subject.title: [bug] 10 skills stuck in pending_checks after staged prepublication pipeline deployment

question: Should recovery for these stuck staged publishes be handled by production worker/table remediation, by a staff-scoped retry/finalize path, or by approving the linked caller-controlled bypass?
rationale: The issue is a real publish blockage, but the proposed bypass changes who can skip the prepublication TruffleHog and ClawScan gate, which is a security-boundary choice that source inspection alone should not settle.

options.title: Inspect and recover the queue first
options.body: Check the production publishAttempts rows and worker logs, then retry or finalize the affected attempts through the existing worker/security path if the rows are clean.

options.title: Land a controlled recovery path
options.body: Add a maintainer- or staff-scoped retry/finalize mechanism with runtime validation and tests if recurring worker outages need an explicit safety valve.

options.title: Approve the public bypass
options.body: Accept the linked PR's publisher-supplied bypass only if maintainers are comfortable with ordinary clients skipping the prepublication gate during outages.

recommendation.title: Inspect and recover the queue first
recommendation.body: Check the production publishAttempts rows and worker logs, then retry or finalize the affected attempts through the existing worker/security path if the rows are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and merged both staged publish PRs and is the strongest history-backed owner for the worker and security-gate decision.
